item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Apple Okujou
  • 発売日: 2019-03-02
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おねがいっ!パイズリ委員長NTR
  • 英語名: Onegaii! Paizuri Iinchou NTR

あらすじ

Haizuri Academy. It previously had a bad rep, but with a recent change in school policy, had risen to the top as a prestigious school.

The secret lied in the school’s student council’s ejaculation management!

Use the bold Inori-chan and the shy new student Nako-chan to move forward in the NTR titjob adventure game!
